class.name: SteamServerStatsResult
class.brief_description: Outcome and native evidence for a dedicated Steam progression action.
class.description: For a submitted edit, success confirms the exact Steam StoreUserStats response. Failed results preserve the number of accepted setters and whether the store was issued. A timeout or cancellation with [member store_submitted] true leaves persistence unknown to the local observer.

method.name: get_applied
method.description: Return the number of setters accepted into the native cache for this action.

method.name: get_failed_at
method.description: Return the zero-based index of a rejected edit, or -1 when no individual edit failed.

method.name: get_steam_result
method.description: Return the exact observed Steam EResult, or 0 when there is no matched native result.

method.name: was_store_submitted
method.description: Return whether Steam assigned a native call handle to the store.

members.member: Number of setters accepted into Steam's cache for this action.
Zero-based index of a rejected edit. Defaults to -1.
Observed Steam EResult, or 0 if unavailable.
Whether Steam accepted a native store request for processing.
